ui.character.feature.ooc_notes.descripti: Anything you want other players to know about you goes here, such as antag information, OOC triggers, etc. Do not put sexual things in here—move those to OOC Notes (NSFW).
ui.character.feature.ooc_notes_nsfw.desc: Same as OOC Notes but requires you to click a tab to view.
ui.character.feature.character_advert.de: An advertisement for your character. Give information on how to approach for those interested, for either regular and erotic roleplay.
ui.character.feature.character_attractio: What your character is attracted to. This is displayed in the Directory.
ui.character.feature.character_gender.de: What classifies as the gender for your character. This is displayed in the Directory.
ui.character.feature.custom_species_name: Appears on examine. If left blank, you will use your default species name (E.g. Human, Lizardperson).
ui.character.feature.records_general.des: Viewable with any records access. For general viewing-things like employment, qualifications, etc.
ui.character.feature.records_security.de: Viewable with security access. For criminal records, arrest history, things like that.
ui.character.feature.records_medical.des: Viewable with medical access. For things like medical history, prescriptions, DNR orders, etc.
ui.character.feature.records_exploitable: Can be IC or OOC. Viewable by certain antagonists/OPFOR users, as well as ghosts. Generally contains things like weaknesses, strengths, important background, trigger words, etc. It ALSO may contain things like antagonist preferences, e.g. if you want to be antagonized, by whom, with what, etc.
Only viewable by yourself and ghosts. You can have whatever you want in here - it may be valuable as a way to orient yourself to what your character is.
ui.character.feature.pda_ringtone.descri: Want your PDA to say something other than "beep"? Accepts the first 20 characters.
ui.character.feature.allow_mismatched_pa: Allows parts from any species to be picked.
ui.character.feature.allow_mismatched_ha: Allows species who normally have a fixed hair color to have different hair colors. This includes in-round sources such as dyeing hair, alter form, etc. Currently only applicable to slimes.
ui.character.feature.allow_genital_parts: Enables if you want to have genitals on your character.
ui.character.feature.allow_emissives.des: Emissive parts glow in the dark.
ui.character.feature.synth_chassis_color: Only works for Synths and chassis that support greyscale coloring.
ui.character.feature.taur_naga_disable_h: If using a serpentine or fishlike taur body, determines if you are immune to caltrops and a few other effects of being barefoot.
ui.character.feature.penis_length.descri: Value is measured in inches. This value is limited to 25 for characters with a body size <= 1, or without the oversized trait. The maximum allowed value scales up based on the body size of a character, up to a max of 86.
ui.character.feature.penis_girth.descrip: Value is circumference, measured in inches. This value is limited to 15 for characters with a body size <= 1, or without the oversized trait. The maximum allowed value scales up based on the body size of a character, up to a max of 35.
ui.character.feature.penis_taur_mode.des: If the chosen taur body has a penis sprite, it will be used instead of the usual.
ui.character.feature.erp_status.descript: All ERP status preferences are merely markers to other players of your preference towards various broad categories of ERP. Selecting no will virtually isolate you from all directed ERP.
ui.character.feature.age_chronological.d: Chronological age represents how long your character has actually existed in the universe since birth. Includes time spent in cryo-sleep and/or in areas of gravity/speed-induced time dilation.
ui.character.feature.age_physical.descri: Physical age represents how far your character has grown physically and mentally. Includes 'normal' aging, such as experiences which physically age the body, and 'anti-aging' medical procedures. Does not include time spent in cryo-sleep.
ui.character.feature.be_antagonist_targe: Controls whether antagonist objective generation prefers your character for kill or round-removal targets. Yes - Kill Without Round Removal allows supported kill targets. Yes - Round Removal also allows marooning, debrain, sacrifice, extraction, and similar round-removal targets. Security jobs set to No are treated as Yes - Kill Without Round Removal during the round. Heretic target selection ignores this setting.
ui.character.feature.round_removal.descr: Controls whether antagonist objective generation prefers your character for kill or round-removal targets. Yes - Kill Without Round Removal allows supported kill targets. Yes - Round Removal also allows marooning, debrain, sacrifice, extraction, and similar round-removal targets. Security jobs set to No are treated as Yes - Kill Without Round Removal during the round. Heretic target selection ignores this setting.
ui.character.feature.footstep_sound.desc: The type of sound you will make when you walk around barefoot.
ui.character.feature.flavor_text.descrip: Appears when your character is examined (but only if they're identifiable - try a gas mask). Do not put sexual things in here?move those to Flavor Text (NSFW).
ui.character.feature.flavor_text_silicon: Only appears if you're playing as a borg/AI. Do not put sexual things in here?move those to Flavor Text (Silicon, NSFW).
